summary: Largest hack of 2023 ($197M) via six flash-loan-funded transactions. The root cause was the donateToReserves() function lacking a post-donation solvency check: it burned eTokens but not dTokens, creating an artificial under-collateralized position that the attacker self-liquidated at a discount. NOTABLY NOT an oracle-price manipulation — the price feed reported legitimate prices throughout.

price_series.label: during_attack
price_series.note: DAI ~$1.0005 — feed stayed honest; the exploit never touched price

expected_guardrail: None (out of scope — not an oracle attack)
notes: INCLUDED AS AN HONEST NEGATIVE CONTROL / SCOPE BOUNDARY, NOT A PREVENTION CLAIM. safe-oracle validates oracle prices; Euler's prices were never anomalous, so safe-oracle correctly returns Ok (no false positive) and would NOT have prevented this attack. loss_usd_in_scope is 0 on purpose. This demonstrates safe-oracle's scope honesty: it stops oracle manipulation, not collateral-accounting / liquidation-logic bugs.
